strings.zh: 柳伯是一个和精灵{NEWLINE}打了五十年交道的强者！{SCROLL}而且……如你所见,{NEWLINE}在这个冰封的道场中{CLEAR}他能使出令每个对手{CLEAR}颤抖的攻击！{SCROLL}即使是冠军大人你,{NEWLINE}也要做好被冰封的觉悟哦。
strings.en: Pryce is a powerhouse who has{NEWLINE}worked with Pokémon for fifty years!{SCROLL}And... as you can see, in this{NEWLINE}frozen dojo he can unleash attacks{CLEAR}that make every opponent tremble!{SCROLL}Even you, Champion, should{NEWLINE}be ready to get frozen solid.

strings.zh: 虽然柳伯很厉害,{NEWLINE}不过冠军大人你更厉害啊！{SCROLL}这是一场超越了{NEWLINE}年龄限制的炽热之战！
strings.en: Pryce is something, but you’re{NEWLINE}something else!{SCROLL}That was a hot battle that{NEWLINE}spanned the generations!

strings.zh: 卡吉镇　精灵道馆{SCROLL}馆主　　柳伯{NEWLINE}认可的训练家！{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}
strings.en: Mahogany Town Pokémon Gym{SCROLL}Leader: Pryce{NEWLINE}Certified Trainer!{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}

strings.zh: 柳伯馆主已经准备退休了,{NEWLINE}所以目前暂停一切道馆挑战。{CLEAR}请回吧。
strings.en: Pryce is preparing to retire, so{NEWLINE}all Gym challenges are suspended{CLEAR}for now. Please leave.

strings.zh: 柳伯师傅又决定不退休了,{NEWLINE}我也因此顺利拜入师傅门下{CLEAR}学习冰系精灵的使用方法。{SCROLL}我最近就学了一招很实用黑雾技能,{NEWLINE}只要你能从柳伯师傅那得到徽章,{CLEAR}我就可以把这招教给你哦。
strings.en: Master Pryce decided not to{NEWLINE}retire after all, so I got to{CLEAR}become his student and learn{CLEAR}how to use Ice-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}I just learned a really useful move,{NEWLINE}Haze. If you get the Badge from{CLEAR}Master Pryce, I can teach it to you.

strings.zh: 你已经从柳伯师傅那拿到
strings.en: You already got the Glacier Badge{NEWLINE}from Master Pryce?
